name: ElevenLabs UI
changes: Mapped shared shadcn controls and project tokens to Agents Kit.
Replaced React Three Fiber and Drei in Orb with the existing Three.js renderer while preserving shaders, props, and uniform behavior.
Replaced ElevenLabs SDK-only public data types with compatible local structural types.
Changed framer-motion imports to the installed motion package.
Added Orb reduced-motion and offscreen pause, capped DPR, cleanup, and render-failure fallback behavior.
Stopped inactive LiveWaveform render loops and reduced nonessential waveform motion.
Prevented disabled demos and cancelled permission requests from retaining microphone streams.
Made AudioScrubber share its requested height with the nested waveform and use a native range input for pointer, touch, and keyboard seeking.
Redraw static waveforms after root theme changes so canvas colors stay readable without reloading.
